Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1991
ACT VI OF 1991
SINDH SERVICE
TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis.B-4/91, dated 13-6-1991.---The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment)
Bill, 1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 8th May,
1991 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th June, 1991 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act
may be called the Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Act XV of 1973

ACT VI OF 1991
ACT VI OF 1991

TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis.B-4/91, dated 13-6-1991.---The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment)
Bill, 1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 8th May,
1991 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th June, 1991 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Act XV of 1973.---In the
Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in
section 2, in clause (c) before the full-stop at the end, the words and figure
"or section 3-B" shall be added.

Insertion of sections 3-B, 3-C, 3-D in Sindh Act XV of 1973

ACT VI OF 1991
ACT VI OF 1991
SINDH SERVICE
TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis.B-4/91, dated 13-6-1991.---The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment)
Bill, 1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 8th May,
1991 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th June, 1991 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
3. Insertion of sections 3-B,
3-C, 3-D in Sindh Act XV of 1973: -In the said Act, after section 3-A. the
following new sections shall be inserted:--
"3-B. Tribunal
for members of the subordinate judiciary.- Notwithstanding anything
contained in section 3, the Chief Justice of the High Court may establish a
Tribunal consisting of three judges of the High Court, the most senior of whom
shall be the Chairman and the other two judges shall act as members of the
Tribunal and the Tribunal so established shall have exclusive jurisdiction in
respect of matters relating to the terms and conditions of service of members
of the subordinate judiciary, including the disciplinary matters."
"3-C. Section
3 A not to apply to the Tribunal under section 3-B.- Nothing contained in
section 3-A shall apply to the Tribunal established under section 3-B."
"3-D. Transfer
of pending cases.--All matters relating to the terms and conditions of
service of members of the subordinate judiciary pending before the Tribunal
referred to in section 3 immediately before the commencement of the Sindh
Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991, shall stand transferred to the
Tribunal established under section 3-B."

Amendment of section 8 of Sindh Act XV of 1973

published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
4. Amendment of section 8 of
Sindh Act XV of 1973: -In the said Act, in section 8, in subsection (1),
the full-stop at the end shall be replaced by colon and thereafter the
following proviso shall be added:--
"Provided that the rules in
respect of the Tribunal established under section 3-B shall be made in
consultation with the High Court."

Repeal of Sindh Ordinance II of 1991
